verdict.rationale: Sentry markets Seer as its own built-in debugging agent that finds root causes and generates merge-ready patches, so users can hand it debugging and fix tasks inside the product. The evidence is only two homepage marketing lines. The Agents Insights material covers monitoring the user's own AI agents, not a built-in assistant, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party Seer docs on how tasks are assigned and what it can do, its scope beyond debugging and fixes, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent](https://sentry.io/product/seer/).
Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
